name: 使用 SAP Ariba Buying 的集中采购引导式采购 (3EN)
name_en: Guided Buying for Central Procurement with SAP Ariba Buying (3EN)
description_en_html:
Overview

Guided buying in SAP Ariba Buying creates a simple, smart, and elegant purchasing experience that increases user engagement across all spend areas. It serves as a central place where all buyers can shop across all goods and services. It enables procurement and individual line-of-business (LoB) owners to specify procurement policies and inform and guide users whenever there appear to be policy conflicts. Central Procurement offers a centralized requisitioning process across industries with a deep integration into the customer's landscape. It connects guided buying in SAP Ariba Buying capability to the customer’s ERP or SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition systems, and exchanges business documents to ensure end-to-end business processes into finance and logistics that run in the connected systems. The integration allows the transfer and updates of the requisition between the two as well as necessary master data.

Key Process Flow

  • Access customized guided buying app and search for items across catalogs, including partial items, forms, and suppliers in a single search box
  • Get policy guidance as items are added to the requisition
  • Enable tactical sourcing by the employee easily
  • Validate and submit requisition for simulation in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition
  • Simulate requisition creation in the connected satellite back end
  • Create purchase requisition and send a request for a guided buying requisition
  • Perform budget checks and other validations in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition before submitting the requisition
  • Approve decisions as per the configured workflow
  • Replicate approved requisition into SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition as purchase requisitions
  • Replicate the purchase requisition in the connected satellite system and receive confirmation that the replication was successful
  • Create purchase orders, goods receipts, and supplier invoices in a connected satellite system with updates of the references in the guided buying requisition history

Business Benefits

  • Run guided buying for the whole organization using SAP Ariba to leverage the central requisitioning processes
  • Increase employee performance with simple guided user experience
  • Apply procurement policies automatically through the guided process
  • Reduce TCO significantly for procurement departments through centralized process
  • Use flexible configuration to allow LoB-specific definition of forms, permissions, and system behavior at field level and for workflows, so each persona in the process only enters their respective data, avoiding clerical errors and streamlining purchasing
description_zh_html:
概览

SAP Ariba Buying 中的引导式采购能够打造简单、智能、卓越的采购体验，提高所有支出领域的用户参与度。它是所有采购商可以购买所有商品和服务的中心位置。它使采购和各个业务范围 (LoB) 所有者能够指定采购政策，并在出现政策冲突时通知并指导用户。集中采购提供跨行业的集中申请流程，并深度集成到客户架构。它将 SAP Ariba Buying 功能中的引导式采购连接到客户的 ERP 或 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 系统，并交换业务凭证以确保将端到端业务流程纳入连接系统中运行的财务和物流中。该集成允许在两者之间传输和更新请购单，以及必要的主数据。

关键流程流

  • 访问自定义的引导式采购应用，并在单个搜索框中搜索目录中的项目，包括部分项目、表单和供应商
  • 将项目添加到申请中时，获取政策指导
  • 支持员工轻松进行战术性寻源
  • 验证并提交申请以在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中进行模拟
  • 在连接的卫星后端模拟申请创建
  • 创建采购申请，并发送引导式购买申请
  • 在提交请购单之前，在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中执行预算检查和其他验证
  • 根据配置的工作流审批决策
  • 将已批准的申请复制到 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 作为采购申请
  • 在连接的卫星系统中复制采购申请，并接收复制成功的确认
  • 在连接的卫星系统中创建采购订单、收货和供应商发票，并更新引导式购买申请历史记录中的参考

业务优势

  • 使用 SAP Ariba 为整个企业运行引导式采购，以利用集中申请流程
  • 通过简单的引导式用户体验提高员工绩效
  • 通过引导式流程自动应用采购政策
  • 通过集中流程显著降低采购部门的总体拥有成本
  • 使用灵活的配置允许针对字段级别和工作流程定义业务线特定的表单、权限和系统行为，因此流程中的每个人员仅输入各自的数据，从而避免文书错误并简化采购
